title: approval_input_v1 — policy authorization profile
description: Offline policy profile applied only after the same document passes approval_input_v1 validation. Issued by the unattended entrypoint after ELIGIBLE_FOR_REMEDIATION and an explicit remediation_enabled opt-in, then authenticated by approval_authenticator and validated by approval_validator before any workspace is prepared.

actor.description: unattended.service_identity of the project configuration. It must use the sp:<name> namespace.

external_reference.description: host_run.run_url, or host_run.run_reference when no URL exists.
